episodes.title: Maksuhäiriö
episodes.summary: Linda, a high-end real estate agent, has lost her husband, leaving her with millions in debt to pay. With the foreclosure process taking away her last assets, Linda tries to keep her life together at all costs. Linda borrows money from her forgotten childhood friend Marke and becomes embroiled in a dirty business scheme.

episodes.title: Rikollisen hyvä tarjous
episodes.summary: Crime follows Linda to the workplace when Marke's boyfriend Sporan's business partner Koistinen shows up at an apartment viewing. Linda has dinner with Koistinen's boss Börje after selling him the apartment. Linda finds the cache Koistinen was looking for and asks her acquaintance Lauri, who has been sidelined, for help in starting a renovation company.

episodes.title: Aluevaltauksia
episodes.summary: Linda and Marke travel to Spain, where Marke discovers the real reason for the trip. Marke is promoted to CEO of Linda's renovation company, Queen of Homes. Back home, Koistinen tries to track down the missing cache. Linda finances her company with cash and assembles a rather unusual but skilled renovation team.

episodes.title: Hajota ja hallitse
episodes.summary: Börje is upset because of Koistinen's disappearance. Linda's nightmares deepen. The renovation team targets the parish house. Linda wants to expand Queen of Homes and persuades the planning department and the parish president to go along with the plan. Spora threatens to expose Linda.

episodes.title: Kaavamuutos
episodes.summary: The body of the missing Koistinen is found. Linda does everything she can to get the project through the planning department and desperately tries to keep the parish president Birgitta out of the way. The name Queen of Homes comes to Linda's workplace. Linda's nightmares start to come true.

episodes.title: Karma kostaa
episodes.summary: Linda confesses everything to Marke. An international company threatens to withdraw from the contract and Linda tries to speed up the deal. Börje learns more about Koistinen's death and Spora has to pay a heavy price for Linda's lies. The noose around Linda's neck begins to tighten and she must make her last risky move.
